name: Nancy

scaling.scaled: 65/45 lb overhead squats, or front squats if overhead mobility isn't there yet. Keep all five runs.
scaling.beginner: PVC or empty-bar overhead squats (or goblet squats), 200m runs, 3-4 rounds. Nancy is secretly a mobility screen — treat a failed overhead position as information, not failure.

origin.summary: Five rounds of a 400m run and fifteen overhead squats at 95/65. The overhead squat is light — the workout is whether your overhead position survives arriving at the bar with a running heart rate, five times. Part of CrossFit's original 'Girls' benchmark series — named workouts introduced by founder Greg Glassman starting in 2003, on the logic that anything that leaves you flat on your back deserves a name like a storm. They serve as repeatable fitness tests: revisit one every few months and the clock tells you whether you're fitter. First posted to CrossFit.com on 2004-12-05.

description: Five rounds of a 400m run paired with overhead squats — combines running-based conditioning with an overhead-stability barbell movement performed under fatigue.
source_notes: crossfit.com/faq/wod (official CrossFit FAQ, 'Explain The Workouts with Names (the Girls)?'), retrieved 2026-07-08
